items.title: Keon Coleman: Team-high yardage total Sunday
items.body_text: Coleman brought in four of six targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in the Bills' 33-30 win over the Raiders on Sunday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Khalil Shakir: Gets into end zone Sunday
items.body_text: Shakir brought in four of six targets for 34 yards and a touchdown in the Bills' 33-30 win over the Raiders on Sunday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kirk Cousins: Impressive numbers in Week 6 loss
items.body_text: Cousins completed 23 of 41 passes for 313 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tanner McKee: Unremarkable in Week 6 start
items.body_text: McKee completed 26 of 45 passes for 215 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while adding one carry for no gain in the Eagles' 25-14 loss to the Panthers on Sunday. He also recovered a fumble. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dameon Pierce: Logs 16 touches in lead role
items.body_text: Pierce rushed 12 times for 35 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 15 yards in the Eagles' 25-14 loss to the Panthers on Sunday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
